name: @yottameta/yotta-compliance
description: YuanGui (yotta-compliance) — a local, deterministic compliance-clause review skill for AI agents: reviews UTF-8 text / Markdown against versioned JSON rule packs with deterministic matching and assertion evaluation, and produces Markdown / JSON reports in which every conclusion carries the source-text span, matched rule id, framework coverage level and official clause citation. Baseline coverage: 11 PIPL rules and 4 cross-border data-transfer rules; the GDPR / HIPAA / SOC2 / PCI-DSS / ISO27001 / China MLPS frameworks are mapping_only. Triggers: reviewing privacy policies, data-processing clauses or personal-information compliance text; checking PIPL or data-export gaps; checking framework coverage; generating reproducible compliance review reports; gating clause review in CI. Boundaries: deterministic rule-based review suggestions only — not legal advice, not a substitute for a lawyer or compliance consultant; the core path uses no LLM and no network access and does not parse PDF / docx; mapping_only frameworks produce no independent compliance conclusion; it does not judge contract validity or litigation outcomes. Fully local, zero-dependency (Python 3.8+ standard library).
